
add_executable(SteamRot main.cpp)

# Define STEAMROT_ENV_DEBUG for the production executable
# This gets applied to all translation units of SteamRot, including the
# recompiled paths.cpp which will use production data paths
target_compile_definitions(SteamRot PRIVATE STEAMROT_ENV_DEBUG)

# Recompile paths.cpp with the production environment flag
# This ensures SteamRot uses data/ while tests use tests/data
# The source file is generated by configure_file in data_providers
target_sources(SteamRot PRIVATE
  ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/src/data_providers/paths.cpp
)

target_compile_options(SteamRot PRIVATE
    $<$<OR:$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:Clang>,$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:GNU>>:
        -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror -Wshadow -Wconversion -Wsign-conversion
    >
)

target_link_libraries(SteamRot PRIVATE
    engine
    error_loop
    display
    types
    logger
    interfaces
)
